meta.title: Émetteur RKP de l'appareil
meta.description: Signe une clé P-256 avec le KeyMint TA de cet appareil, obtient la chaîne de certificats RKP auprès de Google et l'exporte en keybox.xml.
meta.warning: Cette fonction ne fonctionne que sur certains appareils et ne délivre que des certificats RKP. Les méthodes natives utilisent une ABI privée de Qualcomm KeyMint, qui peut varier selon le micrologiciel. Une ABI incompatible peut faire planter le processus de travail ou l’application de confiance. Le keybox exporté contient une clé privée générée par logiciel ; conservez ces fichiers en lieu sûr. Lisez les prérequis avant de continuer. MediaTek utilise uniquement le pont V1 AIDL ; la compatibilité du micrologiciel et l’acceptation du serveur restent non vérifiées.

limitations.partial_device_support: Cela ne fonctionne que sur certains appareils. V1 AIDL nécessite app_process et l’APK AIDL RKP de cet appareil. V2 nécessite /dev/smcinvoke et libkeymasterdeviceutils.so. V1 AIDL: PureSoft HBK=0. Le mode automatique essaie aussi Native V1 après un échec des autres méthodes disponibles.
limitations.rkp_only: Seuls des certificats RKP peuvent être délivrés. Un appareil compatible est nécessaire pour obtenir le CSR signé. La clé privée exportée est générée par logiciel ; aucune clé privée n’est extraite du TEE.

confirm.title: Envoyer une requête au KeyMint TA ?
confirm.body: Cela exécute RKP (V1 / V2) sur l'application de confiance KeyMint de l'appareil et envoie le résultat à Google. Cela ne fonctionne que sur certains appareils et n'émet que des certificats RKP. Les fichiers exportés contiennent une clé privée ; conservez-les en lieu sûr. Continuer ?

renewal.title: Automatic RKP renewal (local build)
renewal.description: TEESimulator / OhMyKeymint · local check every 6 hours · renew with 24 hours remaining · off by default
renewal.unsupported: Requires one active supported backend: TEESimulator code ≥ 75 (one default patch profile, keybox.xml), or ITxiao6666/OhMyKeymint code ≥ 222 (fixed keybox.xml), and a locally verifiable Google-rooted P-256 Keybox. Confirm enable again after migration.
renewal.pausedDescription: Check the status and certificate files first. A request with an unknown result must not be repeated blindly. The old working file is retained whenever rollback is possible.
renewal.privacy: Expiry checks are offline. Only a due renewal or a pending new certificate uses the network. The CSR contains public provisioning data; the Keybox private key stays on this device. Cleanup touches only unchanged, expired files created by this renewal feature. Module load confirmation does not verify a Play Integrity verdict.
renewal.protocol: Use the protocol that already issued successfully on this phone
renewal.consent: Enable future Google RKP requests using the selected protocol when the chain has 24 hours or less remaining? Checks run about every 6 hours while Android is running. At most two attempts per rolling 24 hours; ordinary expiry checks are offline. This calls the same vendor KeyMint interface as manual issuance, whose compatibility depends on firmware. New files are verified, backed up and applied to TEESimulator / OhMyKeymint with load confirmation and rollback. This local build has not completed a live automatic issuance test.
renewal.resumeConsent: Only continue after checking whether the previous request produced a certificate. Resuming after a timeout or crash may allow another request; Google may have accepted the earlier one. Existing cooldowns and request counts remain in force. A pending certificate is reused instead of signing again. After clock correction, wait at least 24 hours; request counts are retained.

results.not_due: Not yet due; local check only
results.offline: No validated network; old file retained
results.rate_limited: Waiting for cooldown / daily request limit
results.pending_offline: New certificate saved; waiting for connectivity
results.revocation_unavailable: New certificate saved; revocation list unavailable
results.pending_expired: Pending certificate is too close to expiry; manual review required
results.target_changed: Target or certificate changed; manual review required
results.new_certificate_revoked: New certificate is revoked; old file retained
results.installing: Applying new certificate and waiting for TEESimulator / OhMyKeymint
results.renewed: New certificate verified and loaded by TEESimulator / OhMyKeymint
results.rolled_back: Replacement was not confirmed; old file restored and loaded
results.rollback_unconfirmed: Old file restoration/load could not be confirmed; inspect manually
results.submission_unknown: Previous submission result unknown; no automatic retry
results.submission_review_required: Issuance failed; manual review required before retry
results.request_failed_retry: Request failed; waiting for retry cooldown
results.target_unsupported: TEESimulator / OhMyKeymint/profile is unsupported or inactive
results.clock_invalid: Clock changed or is invalid; inspect time settings
results.local_check_failed: Local validation failed; manual review required
results.manual_resume: Manually resumed; existing cooldown still applies
results.storage_review_required: Owned-file inventory is full; inspect saved artifacts
results.rollback_absent_unconfirmed: Original file was absent; file removed, runtime state needs checking
results.backend_confirmation_required: Backend changed; review the target and enable again

renewal.protocolHelp: Choose an interface and save it for the next renewal. Saving does not issue a certificate or change the renewal switch. Changes are locked while a certificate is being processed.
renewal.discardConfirm: Keep the current certificate and request cooldown. Candidate files are cleaned only after expiry if unchanged.

diagnostics.operation_busy: Another operation is running; retry later
diagnostics.storage_io_failed: File I/O failed; check storage and access
diagnostics.backend_changed: Old backend has pending work; resolve it before changing backends

renewal.recoverConfirm: Restore the previous file without enabling renewal or contacting a certificate server. If there was no previous file, its absence is restored and runtime state still needs checking.
renewal.omkConsent: OhMyKeymint: replacing the Keybox retires some attestation keys bound to the previous identity; affected apps may need enrollment again. File rollback cannot restore retired app keys. Load evidence uses fresh watcher logs with stable file, configuration and process identity; it is not a Play Integrity verdict. Accept and enable?
